limitationTriage.limitation: The model assumes known shape, an unrestricted Euclidean parameter and exact matching of sampling and posterior error laws.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: What replaces the classification under unknown scale, informative priors or approximate posteriors?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Section 8 records the halfspace calculation under mismatch; a mismatch log-rate proposal from review was not pursued.

limitationTriage.limitation: Group-invariant models with right-Haar posteriors are not covered.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does a hull analogue hold on groups?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Listed as an open direction in Section 8.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: No exact crossover formula for convex sets; Theorem 8 does not locate the crossover and its bound one half can be far from the exact probability.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there an exact crossover formula?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Listed as an open direction in Section 8; Table 2 shows the gap.

limitationTriage.limitation: At hull boundary points Theorem 7 gives coefficient zero and does not determine the finer behaviour.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: What is the finer rate on the boundary?

limitationTriage.limitation: The hull criterion concerns all thresholds and may be triggered only at low thresholds.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: What can be said at conventional levels?

limitationTriage.limitation: Prior-art findings are records of dated searches, not proof of priority.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: No further search would establish priority.

limitationTriage.limitation: Finite checks are floating-point sanity checks of formulas, not proofs.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do the checks fail under a plausible corruption, including under python -O?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Explicit SystemExit checks; corruption negative controls run in the release gate plan.
